$comment: Source recordings generated with the ElevenLabs sound-effects API by tools/audio/generate.mjs and turned into shipped assets by tools/audio/process.mjs. The API has no seed parameter: a take is reproduced from the cached raw file (data/cache/audio/elevenlabs/) and identified by the sha256 recorded in manifest.json. 'take' only distinguishes repeated generations of the same prompt. 'kind' selects processing: loop = seamless equal-power crossfade loop normalised to integrated loudness; oneshot = trimmed, faded and normalised to short-term loudness; multi = one generation holding several separate sounds that is split at silences into <id>-1..n one-shots.

Solid rocket motor burning at full thrust, harsh ragged crackling roar, continuous and unchanging, no music, no voices
